definition: the things you are good at or do well
example: One of my key strengths is staying calm under pressure.

definition: the things you are not good at or need to improve
example: My biggest weakness is that I take on too much work at once.

definition: someone who works well with others toward a shared goal
example: I'm a team player who enjoys collaborating with colleagues.

definition: the latest time by which a task must be finished
example: I always make sure to meet the deadline, even on tight schedules.

definition: a way to say you care deeply about something
example: I'm passionate about building products that help people.

definition: a common opening interview question asking for a brief professional summary
example: When they said 'tell me about yourself,' I gave a two-minute summary of my career.

definition: the skills, education, or experience that make you suitable for a job
example: My qualifications include a degree in marketing and five years of experience.

definition: the knowledge and skill gained from doing a job over time
example: I have three years of experience in customer service.

definition: the duties and tasks you are expected to carry out in a role
example: My main responsibilities were managing the team and reporting to the director.

definition: something important that you succeeded in doing through effort
example: My proudest achievement was increasing sales by 30 percent.

definition: to act and make decisions on your own without being told
example: I took the initiative to redesign our filing system.
persian: پیش‌قدم شدن / ابتکار عمل به خرج دادن

definition: the ability to find good solutions to difficult situations
example: Strong problem-solving skills are essential in this role.

definition: the ability to do work carefully and notice small but important things
example: My attention to detail helps me catch errors before they become problems.

definition: to handle several tasks at the same time
example: In this job you need to multitask during busy hours.
persian: چند کار را همزمان انجام دادن

definition: to do as well as is required or hoped for
example: I'm confident I can meet the expectations of this position.

definition: what you want to achieve in your professional life
example: My long-term career goal is to become a project manager.

term: where do you see yourself in five years?
definition: an interview question about your future career plans
example: 'Where do you see yourself in five years?' is a question I always prepare for.
persian: خودتان را پنج سال آینده کجا می‌بینید؟

definition: to match well with a job, team, or company
example: I believe I'd be a good fit for your company culture.

definition: the belief in working hard and being responsible
example: I have a strong work ethic and rarely miss a deadline.

definition: to take further action or check on something after a first contact
example: I'll follow up with a thank-you email after the interview.

definition: people who can confirm your skills and character to an employer
example: I can provide references from my previous managers if needed.

definition: a letter sent with a CV explaining why you want the job
example: I tailored my cover letter to each company I applied to.

definition: a document summarizing your education, skills, and work history
example: Please attach your résumé when you apply.

definition: to formally request a job in writing
example: I'd like to apply for the marketing position you advertised.
persian: درخواست دادن برای / تقاضای شغل کردن

definition: the amount of pay you hope to receive
example: My salary expectations are in line with the industry average.

definition: to discuss something in order to reach an agreement, like pay
example: I'd like to negotiate the salary before accepting the offer.

definition: the time you must keep working after telling your employer you'll leave
example: I have a one-month notice period at my current job.
persian: مدت اطلاع‌رسانی پیش از ترک کار

definition: to take action in advance rather than waiting for problems
example: I try to be proactive and solve issues before they grow.

definition: able to change easily to fit new conditions
example: I'm adaptable and comfortable working in fast-changing environments.

definition: to do very well and grow in a particular situation
example: I thrive in collaborative, high-energy teams.

definition: to stay effective in stressful or demanding situations
example: I handle pressure well by prioritizing my tasks.

definition: abilities useful across many different jobs
example: Communication and leadership are transferable skills I bring to any role.

definition: to give tasks or responsibilities to other people
example: A good manager knows how to delegate effectively.

definition: practical experience from actually doing something yourself
example: I have hands-on experience with data analysis tools.

definition: to make a useful, positive contribution to a company
example: I'm confident I can add value to your sales team.
